metadata.title: ICE's stock gets a boost from Trade[XYZ] deal, but so do shares of its rivals - MarketWatch

content.text:
Oct. 29, 10:37am ET
ICE's stock gets a boost from Trade[XYZ] deal, but so do shares of its rivals
Shares of Intercontinental Exchange, the parent of NYSE, were rallying 6.3% toward the highest close since early April after the company announced a deal to bring Trade[XYZ]'s perpetual markets on Hyperliquid to the U.S.
That didn't seem to bother ICE's rivals much, as Nasdaq's stock was up 0.9% and CME Group's stock was gaining 1.4%.
Crypto-trading platforms weren't feeling much heat either, as Robinhood Markets shares were easing 0.1% and Coinbase Global's stock was up 0.1%.
